infoTooltipText.message: Mode ya simulation yi kombisa hilaha pheji ri langutekaka hakona eka munhu loyi a nga na ku pfumaleka ka ku vona mihlovo — leswi pfunaka eka vaendli va swifaniso lava kambelaka ntirho wa vona. Mode ya ku lulamisa yi tirhisa daltonization ku cinca mihlovo leyi pfilunganyaka eka ti ranges leti vatirhisi va colorblind vanga ti hambanisaka hiku olova.
infoTooltipText.description: Tooltip text explaining the difference between simulation and correction modes.
